page_title: PSG 5-0 MAR | PSG v Marseille 08/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's the end of the match.
90+1' Leonardo Balerdi (Marseille) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Willy Delajod had an easy-decision to make.
90' We will have 3 min. of added time.

90' OFF THE BAR! Nuno Mendes (PSG) drifts into the box to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from close range, but it crashes against the crossbar! It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
87' Matvey Safonov comes off his line to intercept the corner from Amine Gouiri (Marseille).

86' Igor Paixao (Marseille) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play and Marseille have been awarded a corner kick.
86' What a wasted chance that was! An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Goncalo Ramos (PSG) who loops his header high over the bar.
86' Kang-In Lee (PSG) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
85' Goncalo Ramos (PSG) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball goes out of play. PSG are awarded a corner kick.
84' The referee blows his whistle as Nuno Mendes (PSG) was too aggressive in his challenge.
82' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Emerson (Marseille) was quite harsh and Willy Delajod didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
80' The manager makes a subsitution with Bilal Nadir (Marseille) coming on for Mason Greenwood.
79' Kang-In Lee (PSG) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
75' Luis Enrique prepares a substitution. Ousmane Dembele is replaced by Goncalo Ramos (PSG).
75' Substitution. Senny Mayulu leaves the pitch and is replaced by Dro Fernandez (PSG).
75' Luis Enrique decides to make a substitution. Warren Zaire-Emery will be replaced by Lucas Hernandez (PSG).
74' 5 - 0 Goal - 5:0! Senny Mayulu tees up Kang-In Lee (PSG) inside the box and he rolls the ball into the bottom right corner and past Jeffrey De Lange.
72' The Marseille players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
68' Substitution. Bradley Barcola is replaced by Kang-In Lee (PSG).

66' 4 - 0 What a goal! Ousmane Dembele plays it to Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG), who finds himself unmarked inside the box and slots a first-time shot past Jeffrey De Lange into the bottom left corner. 4:0.
64' 3 - 0 Facundo Medina (Marseille) scores an unlucky own goal! He deflects a shot into his own net.

64' Bradley Barcola (PSG) is untouchable as he tricks his way into the box. His shot, though, lacks a little bit of accuracy and flies a whisker wide of the left post. That would have been a great goal!
63' Referee Willy Delajod sees the trip by Joao Neves (PSG) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
62' Here is a change. Desire Doue is going off and Luis Enrique gives the last tactical orders to Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG).
62' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Benjamin Pavard departs the field of play to be replaced by Himad Abdelli (Marseille).
61' Desire Doue (PSG) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and flies well wide of the left post.
61' A dangerous looking corner kick from Emerson (Marseille) is cleared to safety by the defence.

60' A pass lands at the feet of Timothy Weah (Marseille) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play. Marseille are awarded a corner kick.
59' Willy Delajod shows a yellow card to Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) for his blatant foul.
59' Close! Senny Mayulu (PSG) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post.

56' Igor Paixao (Marseille) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the bottom left corner. The effort, however, is blocked by Matvey Safonov, who pulls off a stunning save!
54' Nuno Mendes (PSG) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Desire Doue.
53' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
52' Senny Mayulu (PSG) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. PSG have a corner.
51' Desire Doue (PSG) creates a good chance for himself and fires in a powerful close-range shot, but his effort ricochets off the left post.

50' Joao Neves (PSG) was close to scoring a goal after unleashing a first-time effort from inside the six-yard box. The ball was aimed low towards the middle of the net, but the goalkeeper read it well and pulled off a brilliant save to thwart the attempt.
49' The PSG players are exchanging some short passes.
46' Roberto De Zerbi has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Igor Paixao (Marseille) comes on the pitch for Ethan Nwaneri.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.

45+3' What a poor attempt! Facundo Medina (Marseille) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes into the stands.
45+1' The corner from Ousmane Dembele (PSG) is hurriedly cleared.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

45' Desire Doue (PSG) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant long-range cross, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem. The linesman points to the corner flag, PSG are going to take it.
43' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and bends his effort inches wide of the left post.

37' 2 - 0 An amazing individual effort from Ousmane Dembele (PSG) ends with a strike from inside the penalty area. He sends the ball precisely into the top right corner and makes it 2:0. Jeffrey De Lange was helpless.
36' Flag goes up against Bradley Barcola (PSG) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
35' Neat passing move from PSG in order to create new attacking opportunities.
32' The resulting corner from Ousmane Dembele (PSG) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
32' Desire Doue (PSG) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the bottom left corner, but Jeffrey De Lange pulls off an exquisite save to deny him. Now PSG have a corner.
30' Quinten Timber (Marseille) misses the target from a promising position, sending the ball well wide of the left post.
28' A player from PSG commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
25' That's unlucky! Desire Doue (PSG) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
24' Benjamin Pavard (Marseille) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
22' Bradley Barcola (PSG) is flagged for offside.
22' Bradley Barcola (PSG) latches onto a good pass inside the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper, but deflects off the left post to safety.
22' 3:1 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
19' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) plays a through ball but overhits it. The ball goes out of play and Marseille will have a goal kick.
18' Timothy Weah (Marseille) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Willy Delajod who sees an offensive foul.
16' The ball possession at the moment is 64:36.
14' Bradley Barcola (PSG) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Jeffrey De Lange comes off the line to clear the ball away.
12' 1 - 0 Fantastic team goal! Ousmane Dembele (PSG) was set free in the area by Nuno Mendes and made no mistake with a lovely finish into the bottom right corner. 1:0.
10' Leonardo Balerdi (Marseille) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
9' Leonardo Balerdi (Marseille) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
9' Vitinha (PSG) has tested the patience of referee Willy Delajod and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.

8' Bradley Barcola (PSG) is untouchable as he tricks his way into the box. His shot, though, lacks a little bit of accuracy and flies a whisker wide of the right post. That would have been a great goal!
6' Marseille enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
3' Desire Doue (PSG) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
3' PSG take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

2' Desire Doue (PSG) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort. The ball is out of play and PSG manage to earn a corner.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. PSG will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Willy Delajod.
